raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "absolute in-plane dimensions",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 specifies Lx:Ly = 6:1 but gives no absolute lengths or coordinate normalization. Its significance depends on the unresolved length units of the filter radius.",
      "readings": [
        "Full beam Lx = 6, Ly = 1; optimized half occupies x/Lx from 1/2 to 1.",
        "Full beam Lx = 180, Ly = 30; optimized half occupies x/Lx from 1/2 to 1."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "element counts on the optimized half",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1.1 gives 180 by 30 elements before saying that the right half is optimized, without explicitly assigning those counts to the full or half domain. Appendix B explicitly uses a 90 by 30 half mesh and repeats the single-material CASE III objective and non-discreteness values.",
      "readings": [
        "180 by 30 describes the full beam; optimize a 90 by 30 right half, with square cells on a uniform grid.",
        "180 by 30 describes the optimized right half; the equivalent full mesh is 360 by 30, with cell width half the cell height on a uniform grid."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "spatial grid spacing",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 specifies bilinear quadrilateral elements, and Sec. 4.1.1 supplies counts, but neither explicitly specifies uniform nodal spacing.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform Cartesian spacing in both directions.",
        "Uniform y spacing; the half of the x columns nearest the loaded midspan have half the width of the remaining columns, preserving the same total width and counts."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "physical support coordinates",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 calls the beam simply supported and refers to Fig. 2a, but the prose supplies no support coordinates. The figure is unavailable.",
      "readings": [
        "Full-beam supports at the lower corners: (0, 0) and (Lx, 0).",
        "Full-beam supports at the end-face midpoints: (0, Ly/2) and (Lx, Ly/2)."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "support footprint on the mesh",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 4.1 and 4.1.1 do not state whether each physical support constrains one node or a finite boundary patch.",
      "readings": [
        "Constrain a single boundary node at each support.",
        "Constrain the nodes spanning one boundary element at each support.",
        "Constrain the nodes spanning two boundary elements at each support."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_type",
      "entity": "physical support retained in the right-half model",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The description 'simply supported' and later references to rollers and hinges do not identify the support retained on the right or give its constrained displacement components.",
      "readings": [
        "Retained support is a vertical-reaction roller: uy = 0, with ux free.",
        "Retained support is a hinge: ux = uy = 0."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "midspan point load in the half model",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 specifies F = 10^-3, while Sec. 4.1.1 uses a symmetric half. The text does not explicitly identify the stated force as the full-beam resultant or the force entered into the half-model load vector.",
      "readings": [
        "Full-beam resultant is 10^-3; apply 5 × 10^-4 to the half model.",
        "Apply 10^-3 to the half model; the corresponding mirrored full-beam resultant is 2 × 10^-3."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "prescribed solid regions at load and support locations",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1.1 describes material occupying load and support portions as a result, but never explicitly specifies whether any such cells are fixed solid rather than designable.",
      "readings": [
        "No passive cells; all cells are designable.",
        "Keep every cell incident on a load or physical-support node fixed solid.",
        "Keep a 2 by 2 element solid pad abutting each load and physical-support location."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "solid Poisson ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 fixes the single solid's normalized Young's modulus, but no Poisson ratio is supplied anywhere in the example.",
      "readings": [
        "Poisson ratio 0.25.",
        "Poisson ratio 0.30.",
        "Poisson ratio 1/3."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "two-dimensional constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The paper specifies a 2-D elastic analysis with bilinear quadrilaterals but does not choose plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress.",
        "Plane strain."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No thickness or per-unit-thickness convention is given for the 2-D stiffness and volume calculations.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit thickness, t = 1 in the chosen length units.",
        "Uniform thickness t = 0.1 in the same length units."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "void stiffness floor",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 and Eq. 33 describe Emin only as a very small stiffness used to avoid singularity; its numerical value is absent.",
      "readings": [
        "Emin/Esolid = 10^-9.",
        "Emin/Esolid = 10^-6.",
        "Emin/Esolid = 10^-3."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "bilinear-quadrilateral stiffness integration",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 names bilinear quadrilateral elements but gives no quadrature rule or stabilization specification, which matters particularly for the checkerboard assessment in Table 2.",
      "readings": [
        "Full 2 by 2 Gauss integration.",
        "Reduced 1-point integration with hourglass stabilization."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "length units of the density-filter radius",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1.1 gives rmin = 3.6, and Eqs. 27–28 use center distances, but no coordinate units or reference element pitch are defined.",
      "readings": [
        "Physical Euclidean radius 3.6 times the vertical cell pitch, giving rmin/Ly = 0.12 on 30 uniform rows.",
        "Physical Euclidean radius 3.6 times the horizontal cell pitch.",
        "Radius 3.6 in coordinates normalized to Ly = 1."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "density filtering across the symmetry cut",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eqs. 27–29 define normalized neighborhood filtering, but Sec. 4.1.1 does not state whether the filter neighborhood is constructed on the computational half or on a mirrored full beam.",
      "readings": [
        "Build the filter on the right half only; truncate and renormalize neighborhoods at the symmetry cut.",
        "Mirror design values across the symmetry cut and filter using full-beam neighborhoods."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "initial single-material design field",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No initial natural-coordinate or density field is specified for Table 2. The initial guesses discussed in Sec. 4.4.2 concern other material counts and the cantilever.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform unfiltered solid density 0.30.",
        "Uniform unfiltered solid density 0.50, corresponding to natural coordinate zero.",
        "Uniform projected solid density 0.30, obtained by inverting the initial projection for CASE III."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "external optimization move limit",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 names MMA and Eq. 34 supplies global variable bounds, but no additional per-iteration move limit is reported.",
      "readings": [
        "No external move limit beyond MMA's internal bounds.",
        "Limit each natural-coordinate change to 0.2 per iteration.",
        "Limit each natural-coordinate change to 0.4 per iteration."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "MMA asymptote and subproblem parameters",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.3 does not report initial asymptote distances, shrink/growth factors, or constraint penalty parameters.",
      "readings": [
        "Initial asymptote distance 0.5 of the variable range; shrink/growth factors 0.7/1.2; constraint penalty c = 1000 and d = 0.",
        "Initial asymptote distance 0.25 of the variable range; shrink/growth factors 0.5/1.1; constraint penalty c = 10000 and d = 1."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "MMA history at projection-continuation updates",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1.1 specifies the projection continuation values and interval, but does not state whether MMA's asymptote history is retained when the projection sharpness changes.",
      "readings": [
        "Retain MMA history and asymptotes through every projection update.",
        "Restart MMA asymptotes and history whenever projection sharpness doubles."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "optimization stopping criterion",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4 specifies a maximum of 400 MMA iterations, but gives no early stopping criterion or convergence tolerance.",
      "readings": [
        "Run exactly 400 MMA updates.",
        "Stop earlier when maximum unfiltered solid-density change is below 10^-3, subject to the 400-iteration cap.",
        "Stop earlier when relative objective change remains below 10^-4 for ten iterations, subject to the 400-iteration cap."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "numerical solution tolerances",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 3.2–3.3 specify equilibrium and MMA but give no equilibrium residual or MMA-subproblem convergence tolerances.",
      "readings": [
        "Relative equilibrium residual tolerance 10^-10 and MMA-subproblem KKT tolerance 10^-8.",
        "Relative equilibrium residual tolerance 10^-6 and MMA-subproblem KKT tolerance 10^-5."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "other",
      "entity": "domain represented by the reported Table 2 objective",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Eq. 42 defines f0 as strain energy, but Table 2 does not explicitly state whether its reported value belongs to the optimized half or the reconstructed full beam.",
      "readings": [
        "Report half-model strain energy: f0 = 0.5 Fhalf^T Uhalf.",
        "Report reconstructed full-beam strain energy: f0 = 2 times the half-model strain energy."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    }
  ]
}
